reasoning_content:
The admin@example.com user exists (id 3), active=true, has a password. So the user record is fine. The login failure might be because I sent `email` instead of `username` in the request. Let me check `can_login?` and `Auth::User.new` — maybe the `verified` flag matters. Actually, `verified=false` for all users. Let me check `can_login?`.

Actually the error was "Login failed." Let me retry with `username` param since that's what `Auth.new(params[:username], ...)` uses. Let me check the frontend form to confirm the param name, and check `can_login?`.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
f=/workspaces/workspace/lib/auth.rb
grep -n "def can_login" -A 8 "$f"
echo "=== User new / user lookup ==="
grep -n "def initialize" -A 10 "$f" | sed -n "1,40p"
grep -n "def user\b\|def user(" -A 10 "$f"
' 2>&1
